claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired teaching art using basic recognizable form, not strict scientific reconstruction; no exact species/measurement/locomotion/coexistence claim.

reconstruction_notes.en: Broad original horseshoe shield has swept rear wings, a bilobed center and deep notches with upward eyes. Short soft body, lateral flaps and paired rake appendages are original simplified geometry; fine filter/spine/segment counts, palette, nominal size and pose are artistic. Not a crab recolor, exact species/specimen or animated feeding reconstruction.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创宽马蹄甲保留后掠侧翼、双叶后中部和容纳向上眼的深切口。短软躯体、侧游泳瓣及成对耙状前附肢均为原创简化几何；细滤刺/体节数量、配色、名义尺寸和姿态属美术选择，非蟹换色、精确物种标本或取食动画复原。

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish broad horseshoe carapace with swept rear wings and deep eye notches in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以宽马蹄形甲壳、后掠侧翼与深眼切口搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。
